_note_min_hours: DSKP KSSM upper-secondary English (Form 4 & 5) states a minimum of 112 contact hours per year, fewer than the 144 hours of lower secondary (Form 1-3). Verify against your school's time-table allocation.

language_focus_examples: Present and past tenses (review and extension)
Present perfect and present perfect continuous
Future forms (will / going to / present continuous)
Connectors and linkers for extended writing
_note_structure: Keys 'bidang' (=Skill), 'standard_kandungan' (=Content Standard) and 'standard_pembelajaran' (=Learning Standard) reuse the engine's keys. Wording matches the official DSKP Form 4.

standard_kandungan.nama: Understand meaning in a variety of familiar contexts

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Understand independently the main ideas in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics.
Understand independently specific information and details in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics.
Recognise independently attitudes or opinions in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics.
Understand independently more complex questions on a wide range of familiar topics.
Understand independently longer simple narratives on a wide range of familiar topics.

standard_kandungan.nama: Use appropriate listening strategies in a variety of contexts

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Guess the meaning of unfamiliar words from clues provided by other words and by context on a wide range of familiar topics.

standard_kandungan.nama: Recognise features of spoken genres on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Recognise with support typical features at word, sentence and text levels of a range of spoken genres.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate information, ideas, opinions and feelings intelligibly on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Explain simple content on familiar topics from what they read and hear.
Ask about and explain causes and consequences of actions, events and simple processes.
Explain advantages and disadvantages of plans and ambitions.
Explain and justify own point of view.
Express and respond to feelings such as amusement, anger and regret.
Use formal and informal registers appropriately in most familiar contexts.
Confirm understanding in discourse-level exchanges by repeating back what a speaker has said.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate appropriately to a small or large group on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Summarise the main points of a story, text or plot.

standard_kandungan.nama: Understand a variety of texts by using a range of appropriate reading strategies to construct meaning

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Understand the main points in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics.
Understand specific details and information in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics.
Guess the meaning of unfamiliar words from clues provided by other words and by context on a wide range of familiar topics.
Use independently familiar and some unfamiliar print and digital resources to check meaning and extend understanding.
Recognise with little or no support the attitude or opinion of the writer in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics.
Recognise with support typical features at word, sentence and text levels of an increased range of genres.

standard_kandungan.nama: Explore and expand ideas for personal development by reading independently and widely

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Read a variety of suitable print and digital texts to investigate and analyse national issues.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate intelligibly through print and digital media on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Explain information from diagrams, charts, tables, graphs or other visuals.
Explain causes and consequences of actions, events or simple processes.
Explain the main points of an idea or argument.
Express and respond to opinions and common feelings such as amusement, anger and regret.
Organise, sequence and develop ideas within a text of several paragraphs on familiar topics.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate with appropriate language, form and style

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Punctuate written work on a range of text types with reasonable accuracy.
Spell written work on a range of text types with reasonable accuracy.
Produce an extended plan or draft and modify this appropriately in response to feedback or independently.
Use formal and informal registers appropriate to the target audience in most familiar situations.

standard_kandungan.nama: Engage with, respond to and interpret a variety of literary text types

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Explain briefly the feelings and opinions a text provokes in them.
Explain in detail the development of plot, characters and themes in a text.

standard_kandungan.nama: Analyse and evaluate a variety of literary text types

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Evaluate and explain briefly stylistic features an author uses to show character, events or place.

standard_kandungan.nama: Express an imaginative response to literary texts

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Respond imaginatively and intelligibly through creating writing scripts and creating props for a short play.

_note_rpt: RECONSTRUCTED Scheme of Work (Rancangan Pengajaran Tahunan) for a ~40-week Malaysian school year. The 12 textbook units are spread evenly (about 2-3 weeks each) with assessment and revision weeks inserted. Week numbers and pacing are a planning guide only, not an official BPK RPT. 'standard_kandungan' lists the Content Standard codes emphasised that week (all 5 skills recur throughout the year).

rpt.catatan: School orientation, diagnostic assessment, CEFR placement and classroom routines.
Kindness and empathy; present/past tense review; short narrative writing.
Describing role models; justifying opinions (2.1.4); biography reading.
Tolerance and harmony; group discussion; literature response begins.
Revision of Units 1-3; first formative assessment (PBD).
Urban farming; poem 'What Makes a Garden Grow'; advantages/disadvantages writing (4.1.2).
E-services and digital life; explaining processes; modals.
Medical advances; passive voice; cause and consequence writing (4.1.2).
Mid-year examination covering Units 1-6.
Mid-year school holiday; optional holiday reading task.
Nutrition and healthy choices; quantifiers; discussing advantages/disadvantages (2.1.3).
Wellness and prevention; conditionals; literature stylistic analysis (5.2.1).
Community and civic responsibility; reading national issues (3.2.1); argument writing (4.1.3).
Revision of Units 7-9; second formative assessment (PBD).

rpt.unit: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned
rpt.catatan: Saving and budgeting; interpreting charts and visuals (4.1.1).
Smart spending and consumer rights; reported speech; formal/informal register (4.2.4).
Online consumerism and digital safety; imaginative response / short play (5.3.1).
Consolidated literature component; plot/character/theme analysis; scriptwriting and props for a short play.
Comprehensive revision of Units 1-12 and all skills.
Final year-end examination.
Post-exam projects, presentations, HOTS and 21st-century-skills activities.
Self-assessment, portfolio review and preparation for Form 5 (B1 High).
